opening.argument: The video presents health education about gallstones, bile, and related dietary or medical topics, beginning with an explanation of “the real cause of gallstones” and using a detergent demonstration to illustrate bile. It discusses proposed solutions for dissolving stones and recommends a bile-salt concentrate called “gallbladder formula,” followed by an invitation to “check the. Link below.” But that recommendation does not, on the supplied information, establish deceptive conduct, payment requirements, product efficacy, or any transaction outcome. The accompanying guidance expressly limits the material to general information and says viewers should consult a physician before changing their health regimen or diet, obtaining a medical exam, diagnosis, and recommendation. Those warnings and the educational presentation support treating the material as health information and operational demonstration, without overstating what the product or link achieves.
